title: Controlling multiparameter quantum estimation in exciton-optomechanics system
summary: Multiparameter quantum estimation has emerged as a central task in quantum metrology. In this work, we investigate multiparameter quantum estimation in a hybrid exciton--optomechanical (EOM) system. The system consists of a semiconductor quantum well embedded inside a driven optomechanical microcavity, where the excitonic, optical, and mechanical modes interact coherently through exciton--photon and radiation-pressure couplings.
